scholarships.name: Find scholarships and bursaries
scholarships.description: Lancaster has generous scholarships for both

scholarships.name: India Scholarship- Undergraduate
scholarships.description: Lancaster University will offer a generous scholarship to undergraduate students from India.

scholarships.name: Lancaster Bursary
scholarships.description: Lancaster University will offer a £1,000 bursary for home undergraduate students who are eligible for UK Government funding support.

scholarships.name: Undergraduate International Regional Scholarship
scholarships.description: Lancaster University will offer a generous scholarship to undergraduate international students, from 14 underrepresented countries.

scholarships.name: Excellence Scholarship - International
scholarships.description: Lancaster University will offer a generous scholarship to high-achieving international undergraduate students who make Lancaster their firm choice.

scholarships.name: Excellence Scholarship - Home
scholarships.description: Lancaster University will offer a generous scholarship to high-achieving home undergraduate students who make Lancaster their firm choice.

scholarships.name: International Study Centre Progression Scholarship
scholarships.description: Lancaster University will offer a generous scholarship to high-achieving Lancaster University International Study Centre students who progress to undergraduate study.

scholarships.name: Lancaster Sanctuary Scholarship
scholarships.description: A scholarship for students who are refugees or have humanitarian protection, with support and resources to help them integrate into our community here at Lancaster.

scholarships.name: Cowrie Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.description: A scholarship for a UK student of Black African or Caribbean heritage starting undergraduate study in 2026.

scholarships.name: Postgraduate International Regional Scholarship
scholarships.description: Lancaster University will offer a generous scholarship to postgraduate international students, from 14 underrepresented countries

scholarships.name: India Scholarship- Postgraduate
scholarships.description: Lancaster University will offer a generous scholarship to postgraduate students from India.

scholarships.name: Lancaster Master's Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.description: Lancaster University will offer a generous scholarship to high achieving postgraduate students.

scholarships.name: Alumni Loyalty Scholarship
scholarships.description: 10% off fees for all Taught Master's degrees if you are a Lancaster graduate.

scholarships.name: Master’s Scholarship for Black British Students
scholarships.description: This scholarship will provide a full fee waiver and stipend of £9,000, for living costs

scholarships.name: Management School MBA Scholarships
scholarships.description: For students studying Lancaster's MBA programmes.

scholarships.name: External scholarships for postgraduate students
scholarships.description: Scholarships from external funders for postgraduate students at Lancaster University.

scholarships.name: GREAT Scholarships
scholarships.description: Support for students from France, Ghana, Indonesia and Spain.

scholarships.name: China Scholarships Council
scholarships.description: Funding for tuition fees, living costs and flights for Chinese PhD students, following a successful application.

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Scholarships
scholarships.description: Full funding for international postgraduate students, depending on eligibility criteria.

scholarships.name: Higher Education Scholarships for Palestinians
scholarships.description: A joint award from the British Council's HESPAL scheme and Lancaster University for Palestinian Master's students.

scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarships
scholarships.description: Full funding for international postgraduate students, depending on eligibility criteria.

scholarships.name: LPDP Scholarship
